name: Patrick Barin
headline: FinTech | Strategy & Product | Ex-Stanford, UC Berkeley, TU Munich
summary:
I’m a product leader passionate about building impactful solutions from the ground up with experience across fintech, e-commerce, and sustainability, driving growth, innovation, and customer value.

At Parcel Perform, I co-lead a cross-functional team to scale a new business unit, developing an e-commerce solution for SMEs. Beyond the product itself, I own the go-to-market strategy, marketing, distribution, and partnerships.

At StashAway, I played a key role in building multiple teams, including Financial Planning, B2B Solutions, and Funding. I developed and managed payment channels across five countries, significantly contributing to the company’s growth in AUM and aligning customer needs with business strategy.

In the past, I also co-founded my own company, Eleza, initially a knowledge-sharing platform that we later pivoted into a social sustainability consultancy. While giving up on our initial idea was painful, this experience taught me the importance of adaptability, customer feedback, and strategic decision-making in navigating market changes and building solutions that truly resonate. Earlier in my career, I consulted for global brands like McDonald’s and Microsoft, honing stakeholder management skills in complex environments.

What drives me is the challenge of 0-to-1 product development—defining strategy, developing customer-centric solutions, and iterating based on data. Whether scaling teams, launching products, or collaborating with stakeholders, I’m committed to delivering thoughtful, data-driven solutions that make a difference—all while keeping the customer at the heart of every decision.
